evidence_summary: Planning Committee endorsed implementation work, but its report states that the formal constitutional changes would be considered by Assembly later in November; no later decision existed at the snapshot date.
Full Council considered the Monitoring Officer's constitutional amendments, including committee terms, officer delegations, planning code and Planning Scheme of Management.

Bexley's official report titled 'Scheme of delegation and Planning Committee Terms of Reference' was prepared for Council on 4 November, two days after the snapshot; adoption therefore remained pending.
Extraordinary Full Council considered and approved constitutional and Planning Committee terms-of-reference changes for the NSD.
Council retained three planning bodies with reduced membership until May 2027 and introduced the statutory gateway arrangements from 31 October.
Full Council resolved to approve constitutional amendments aligning Camden with the NSD.

Planning and Transportation Committee approved the necessary Scheme of Delegations and terms-of-reference amendments on 8 September; Policy and Resources endorsed the package on 24 September, the Court considered it on 8 October, and the current three-panel arrangements operate from October.
Full Council received the General Purposes Committee recommendations and amended Parts 3, 4K and 5D for the NSD.
Council adopted new planning decision rules and a Planning Committee Gateway Protocol.
Council approved constitutional changes, revised Planning Committee terms, referral protocol, planning code and gateway request form.
Council approved changes to the Constitution for the NSD.
Full Council adopted new Planning Committee terms of reference effective 31 October and delegated consequential amendments to the Monitoring Officer.
Full Council's constitution review included and approved the NSD appendix and associated officer-responsibility changes.
Full Council considered constitutional changes implementing the NSD before commencement.
Council approved constitutional and planning-procedure updates aligned with the NSD.
Full Council approved constitutional amendments and a replacement Planning Committee; the council published confirmation.
Council approved an updated Chapter 7 on Planning Decisions, effective 31 October.
Special Council approved revised Planning Committee terms, nominated roles and consequential constitutional amendments.
Council approved constitutional amendments effective 31 October and disbanded the Planning Sub-Committees.
Full Council adopted planning procedure changes for the NSD, including revised committee arrangements and nominated roles.
Council considered and approved the Corporate and Resources Committee recommendation to amend the Constitution for the 2026 Regulations.
Council approved 2026/27 constitutional changes including the NSD and gateway arrangements.
Council resolved to replace local referral thresholds with the national schedules and gateway test, nominate roles, and amend the Constitution.
The Development and Planning Applications Committee approved the new delegation and gateway arrangements.

A detailed constitutional amendment package was before Full Council at 7pm on the snapshot date. The report sought approval of the gateway, committee and officer-delegation arrangements, but no Council outcome yet existed when checked earlier that day.
Full Council considered the revised Constitution and planning committee reforms for implementation from 31 October.
Full Council resolved to approve revised Planning Committee terms of reference, procedure rules and planning protocol, and authorised consequential constitutional amendments for the NSD.
Post-commencement committee papers show the nominated officer/member gateway operating under the NSD.
Full Council considered the Strategy and Resources Committee recommendation and constitutional planning reforms.
Full Council approved reforms to both planning committees, terms of reference and the statutory gateway arrangements.
Full Council adopted revised Planning Committee rules aligned to the 2026 Regulations.
Council confirmed that Full Council changed the Constitution on 21 October, effective for decisions from 1 November.
Full Council approved constitutional changes for the NSD; Westminster's planning page reflects the live delegation rules.
